fee_notes: Royalty (Service Fee) is 6% of Gross Sales with $1,250/month minimum for new franchisees; Conversion/Co-Brand get 3% for first 12 months then 6%. Ad Fee is 2% (1% first year for Conversion/Co-Brand). Tiered rebate structure reduces effective rates at higher sales volumes (e.g., 3.75% royalty + 1% ad fee above $10,258,153).
raw_excerpt: Service Fee equal to 6% of Gross Sales...greater of $1,250 or 6% of Gross Sales...Ad Fee equal to 2% of Gross Sales...Technology Fee of $175 per month
